items.distractor_fact: A daidai wannan lokacin, Hukumar Filin Jirgin Sama ta yi rikodin zafin iska a matsayin digiri {D}°C.
items.gloss_en: At that same time, the Airport Authority recorded the air temperature as {D}°C. The °C symbol follows the number directly and never inflects.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different town's weather station (a PLACE); this one belongs to an organisation, the Airport Authority, running its own instrument.

items.distractor_fact: A wannan rana, wani dillalin hatsi daban ya sayar da hatsi akan farashin $ {D}.
items.gloss_en: That day, a different grain trader sold grain at a price of ${D}. The $ symbol precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different market in a named town (a PLACE); this one belongs to an individual trader (a PERSON).

items.distractor_fact: Madatsar ruwan Tiga ta kai matakin ruwa na mita {D} a wannan rana.
items.gloss_en: Tiga Dam reached a water level of {D} metres that day. 'mita' follows the number as an invariant unit noun.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different natural river (a PLACE); this one is an engineered dam structure, a different kind of owner.

items.distractor_fact: A lokaci guda, wata kamfani mai suna daban tana da balan-balon dubawa wanda ya kai tsayin mita {D} bisa matakin ƙasa.
items.gloss_en: At the same time, a different company had a survey balloon that reached a height of {D} metres above ground level. 'mita' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different drone (an INSTRUMENT with no stated operator); this one belongs to a named company (an ORGANISATION) running a different kind of craft.

items.distractor_fact: A ranar nan, wani matafiyi daban yana da kwalarsa mai nauyin kilogiram {D} a filin jirgin sama.
items.gloss_en: That day, a different traveller had his suitcase weighing {D} kilograms at the airport. 'kilogiram' is an invariant unit noun after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is an unnamed different parcel (an OBJECT with no personal owner); this one belongs to a specific traveller (a PERSON).

items.distractor_fact: A wannan shekara, wata ƙungiyar attajirai a birni dabam tana da mutum {D} a cikin membobinta.
items.gloss_en: This year, a traders' association in a different city has {D} people among its members. 'mutum' stays invariant as the human-count measure word after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different neighbouring village (a PLACE); this one belongs to a traders' association (an ORGANISATION).

items.distractor_fact: A lokaci guda, wani matukin babura daban ya yi tafiya da gudun kilomita/awa {D} a wata hanya dabam.
items.gloss_en: At the same time, a different motorcyclist travelled at {D} km/h on a different road. 'kilomita/awa' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different car (an INSTRUMENT with no named rider); this one belongs to a specific motorcyclist (a PERSON).

items.distractor_fact: A wannan rana, asusun tallafin karatu na wata makaranta dabam yana da $ {D} a ciki.
items.gloss_en: That day, a different school's scholarship fund had ${D} in it. $ precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different student (a PERSON); this one belongs to a school's scholarship fund (an ORGANISATION).

items.distractor_fact: A wannan wata, wani reshen banki dabam yana da € {D} a asusun ajiyarsa.
items.gloss_en: This month, a different bank branch had €{D} in its reserve account. € precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different account holder (a PERSON); this one belongs to a bank branch (an ORGANISATION).

items.distractor_fact: A wannan wata, wani kamfani dabam ya samu kuɗin shiga na $ {D}.
items.gloss_en: This month, a different company earned income of ${D}. $ precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different individual trader (a PERSON); this one belongs to a company (an ORGANISATION).

items.distractor_fact: A wani zaman horo na keɓaɓɓe, wani ɗan wasa daban ya zura ƙwallo {D}.
items.gloss_en: In a separate individual training session, a different player scored {D} goals. 'ƙwallo' stays invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different team (an ORGANISATION); this one belongs to a lone player training individually (a PERSON), not a team.

items.distractor_fact: Wani manomi daban ya girbe tan {D} na amfanin gona a wannan lokacin girbi, ko da yake ba a ambaci masa burin girbi ba.
items.gloss_en: A different farmer harvested {D} tonnes of produce this harvest period, although no harvest target set for him was mentioned. 'tan' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different factory (an ORGANISATION) with its own unstated target; this one belongs to an individual farmer (a PERSON) whose own unstated target likewise does not apply to the factory's stated target (rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Wata mai sana'ar kai-kai daban ta sayar da kaya kan darajar $ {D} a wannan wata, ba tare da an ambaci mata burin sayarwa ba.
items.gloss_en: A different self-employed seller sold goods worth ${D} this month, without any sales target set for her being mentioned. $ precedes the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different shop (an ORGANISATION) with its own unstated target; this one belongs to an individual self-employed seller (a PERSON) whose own unstated target does not apply to the shop's stated target (rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Wata cibiyar nazarin muhalli mai zaman kanta ta yi rikodin ruwan sama na millimita {D} a wannan wata, ba tare da an ambaci wani hasashen da aka yi mata ba.
items.gloss_en: A different independent environmental research institute recorded {D} millimetres of rainfall this month, without any forecast made for it being mentioned. 'millimita' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different town (a PLACE) with its own unstated forecast; this one belongs to a research institute (an ORGANISATION) whose own unstated forecast likewise does not apply to the forecast named in the story (rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Wata na'urar kwaikwayon wasan golf ta yi rikodin bugu {D} a wani zagaye na gwaji, ba tare da an ambaci wani daidaiton fili da aka sa mata ba.
items.gloss_en: A golf simulator machine recorded {D} strokes in a test round, without any par setting for it being mentioned. 'bugu' stays invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different golfer on a different course (a PERSON); this one is a simulator machine (an INSTRUMENT) whose own unstated par likewise does not apply to the par named in the story (rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: Wata kamfanin jirgin sama daban ya sauka a minti {D} bisa lissafin agogo, ba tare da an ambaci jadawalinsa ba.
items.gloss_en: A different airline's flight landed at minute {D} on the clock, without its own timetable being mentioned. 'minti' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different freight train on a different rail line (an INSTRUMENT); this one belongs to an airline (an ORGANISATION) whose own unstated timetable does not apply to the schedule named in the story (rule 6).

items.distractor_fact: A gasar sada zumunta ta keɓaɓɓu, wani gogaggen ɗan wasa daban ya zura ƙwallo {D}.
items.gloss_en: In a separate friendly exhibition match, a different veteran player scored {D} goals. 'ƙwallo' stays invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different team in a different competition (an ORGANISATION); this one is a lone veteran player (a PERSON) playing in an exhibition, not a team.

items.distractor_fact: A ranar wasannin motsa jiki na wata makaranta dabam, tawagar gudu ta makarantar ta kai nisan mita {D} daga layin farawa.
items.gloss_en: On a different school's sports day, that school's relay team reached {D} metres from the start line. 'mita' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a different individual runner in a different race (a PERSON); this one belongs to a school's relay team (an ORGANISATION).

items.distractor_fact: Wata tashar sa ido ta sararin samaniya ta nuna zafin iska na digiri {D}°C a wannan rana.
items.gloss_en: A weather satellite station showed an air temperature of {D}°C that day. The °C symbol follows the number and never inflects.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a third town (a PLACE); this one is a satellite monitoring station (an INSTRUMENT).

items.distractor_fact: Injin ɗagawa na wata kamfanin gine-gine dabam ya kai tsayin mita {D} a wurin aikinta.
items.gloss_en: A crane belonging to a different construction company reached a height of {D} metres at its work site. 'mita' is invariant after any number.
items.entity_note: First distractor's owner is a third tower (a PLACE/structure); this one belongs to a construction company's crane (an ORGANISATION-operated INSTRUMENT).
